title: Review of FCH gated micelles (SIBWD): replicated on seed 9 with both gate controls (beta=0, chi_q=0); Supported for S, I, B, W, D
summary: After the claim's fission strips, I re-ran world.py, world_beta0.py and world_chiq0.py on seed 9 (100 frames, t=400). From white noise ~31 micelles form by t=16 and divide in waves (labkit: 22 persistent splits, max generation 4, 0 merges, identical in all three arms because shell and cargo are passive). Each micelle carries a q ring (rim/core 11, rim/outside 4.8, 239/242 membrane-like) and holds the cargo at 21-31x the outside from t~160 on (cargo_contrast.py; 98-100% of bodies >= 2x, the weakest being freshly split or nucleated bodies, e.g. 1.0x at t=160 and 3.5x at t=400). Freshly divided daughters show up as cyan, cargo-poor micelles in the sheet and refill over ~50 t. beta=0: 1.1x by t=280. chi_q=0: no ring (rim/core 0.94) and containment falls to 2.6-6.3x.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0 white noise everywhere; micelles at t=16
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: compact micelles of constant size persist between fission waves
observations.B: rerun/FACTS.md: shell q rim/core 11, rim/outside 4.78 (239/242 individuals); rerun_chiq0/FACTS.md: 0.94 without the adsorption drift, and containment drops to 2.6-6.3x, so the layer does work
observations.W: cargo_contrast.txt: 21-31x aggregate from t=160 to t=400, 98-100% of bodies >= 2x; rerun_beta0 (gate off, same seed) 1.1x
observations.D: rerun/lineage.png: 22 persistent splits, generation 4, 0 merges; sheet t=156-192 shows dumbbells pinching into two ringed micelles

verdicts.limitation: Shell and cargo are passive tracers with no effect on the amphiphile, so division (by the open feed, in synchronized waves) and inheritance of contents are those of plain fed FCH micelles; the shell is a 2-3 px adsorption layer set by a chosen potential of u. Daughters lose cargo at the neck and start nearly empty (cyan micelles), refilling from their own production. No Laplacian-only twin.
